name: David B. Lever
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in White Plains, New York
about: Attorney David B. Lever is a founding member of Lever & Ecker, PLLC, based in White Plains, New York. A top-rated plaintiff's trial lawyer with more than 35 years of total legal experience, Mr. Lever provides unmatched counsel and support to clients throughout White Plains, Westchester County and the surrounding greater New York City metro area who have suffered significant injury or loss as a result of someone else's negligence or wrongdoing. Mr. Lever also serves in an Of Counsel role to Block O'Toole & Murphy, a preeminent and highly respected plaintiff's personal injury law firm in New York City.

Having devoted his entire legal career to personal injury law, Mr. Lever has achieved remarkable success fighting for the rights and entitlements of innocent accident victims and their families, and he has recovered hundreds of millions of dollars in total compensation for those suffering needlessly through no fault of their own. He is passionate about the work he does and has an unwavering focus on helping his clients obtain the maximum amount of compensation possible under the law.

Honored for his outstanding professionalism and service, Mr. Lever has earned consistent top rankings and endorsements from his peers, including most recently a 2024 Super Lawyers designation of Top 25 attorneys in Westchester County, New York and 2024 Top 100 ranking from The National Trial Lawyers. He has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients and colleagues, and he finds great satisfaction in being able to help so many in his community during their times of dire need.

A 1986 graduate of Ithaca College, Mr. Lever obtained his Juris Doctor in 1989 from Pace University School of Law. He holds licenses to practice in New York and New Jersey, and is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 3rd Circuit and the U.S. Supreme Court.

Mr. Lever is an active member of the New York State Trial Lawyers Association, the New York State Bar Association, the Bronx County and Westchester County Bar Associations, the White Plains Bar Association and the Executive Committee of the Justice Brandeis Law Society 9th Judicial District. In addition, Mr. Lever proudly serves on the Board of Directors for Adults & Children with Learning Disabilities, Inc., a leading not-for-profit agency on Long Island that supports the needs of individuals with autism, learning and developmental disabilities and their families.
